A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 46-page versions of RealPDEBench, with matching main sections and Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of all dimensions.

before.justification: v1 reports original physical measurements, simulations, and model evaluations across five datasets, including benchmark results in Section 4 and additional analyses in Appendices A and B.4.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original measurements, simulations, benchmark results, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The benchmark procedures and model adaptations are unchanged, including modality masking and the Combustion surrogate in Appendix D and baseline implementations in Appendix E.

E1.justification: Both versions use Cylinder, Controlled Cylinder, FSI, Foil, and Combustion under the same three tasks: simulated training, real-world training, and simulated pretraining followed by real-world finetuning.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain DMD, U-Net, CNO, DeepONet, FNO, WDNO, MWT, GK-Transformer, Transolver, and both DPOT sizes. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Parameter-level splits, preprocessing, evaluation metrics, model configurations, and experimental settings are identical. The same 1-, 2-, 3-, 5-, and 10-round autoregressive evaluations are retained.

E4.justification: The autoregressive, frequency-band, and mean-velocity-profile analyses in Section 4.5 and Appendix A are unchanged, as are the simulation-versus-measurement analyses in Appendix B.4 and qualitative examples in Appendix G.

E5.justification: Repetition information and statistical reporting are identical, including three FSI measurements per experiment in Appendix B.2 and Figure 3a's summaries over ten baseline values. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, rankings, plots, and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout Section 4 and the appendices. This includes Tables 1–6 and 8–9 and the prediction visualizations.

T1.justification: The prediction mapping, metric definitions in Section 3, and DMD formulation in Appendix E.1 are identical. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark contributions and claims about simulation-to-reality discrepancies and the benefits of simulated pretraining.

C2.justification: Result interpretations remain identical. Appendix F retains the same limitations concerning domain coverage, dedicated Combustion metrics, and the absence of systematic exploration of strong out-of-distribution regimes.

D1.justification: Data acquisition and processing details, code interfaces, training procedures, and baseline configurations in Appendices B–E are unchanged. The reproducibility statement and code, data, checkpoint, and log access information are also retained.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list, and comparisons with earlier benchmarks are identical. The updated publication header does not change the paper's research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 replaces 'Preprint.' with 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026' and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The acknowledgments add Chunyu Liu for discussions and revise the credit to previously named contributors; scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–21 and Tables 1–9 retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. Apart from the publication/version text and acknowledgment rewrapping, the page layout is unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 updates publication labels and acknowledgments while preserving the scientific content, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information. These administrative edits produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
